info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Labels API enables users to access and list shipment labels associated with logistics operations. This functionality is essential for businesses managing their shipping processes and helps improve tracking and documentation tasks. Typical consumers include logistics managers, warehouse operators, and developers looking to integrate shipping label functionalities into their applications. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline label management and enhance their logistics workflow.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the label for a specific shipment, allowing users to access essential shipping details and documentation needed for package handling.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve shipment label information. It should contain the necessary parameters needed to generate or fetch the shipment label related to the specific shipments.

ListLogisticsShipmentsLabelsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the label operations on shipments in the GET method. It is expected to be a string that contains the relevant data for processing the request.
